verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Glama Chat as a multi-model chat interface for asking AI models questions, such as turning text into diagrams or querying uploaded documents. Nothing shows natural-language commands that operate Glama's own functions, like searching the registry, deploying servers or configuring the Gateway. Chatting with third-party models is an adjacent feature, not NL control of the product, and Glama's directory API exposes no first-party natural-language or agent interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
